description: Customer master (MX, CO, AR), one row per customer. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.customers. Contains personal data (names, document, contact details, date of birth): mask outside Silver. Email is not an identity key; authenticate on document_type + document_number plus a second factor.

load.notes: Single CSV snapshot re-delivered in full. As-of date of the snapshot: 2026-06-18. Reads workspace.bronze.branches (full table) to validate registration_branch_id. customer_status vs Active products (issue 20) is flagged in silver.products.customer_status_conflict, not here.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier (CLI-XXXXXXXXXXXX), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by products, transactions, interactions, complaints, surveys and campaign sends.

document_type.description: Identity document type, canonical casing. Every Mexican customer carries DNI, an Argentine document (see doc_type_inconsistent). Part of the natural key and of authentication.

document_number.description: PII. Identity document number, trimmed and upper-cased. Unique (150,000 of 150,000); with document_type it is the natural key and the authentication identifier.

email.description: PII. Contact e-mail, lower-cased. NOT an identity key: 79,930 of 147,016 customers with an e-mail share it with someone else (issue 9). Never authenticate or join on it.

mobile_phone.description: PII. Mobile phone in international format. Mexican numbers carry +54 (see check phone_prefix_matches_country).

landline_phone.description: PII. Landline phone in international format; missing for about half of the customers.

city.description: City of residence (16 cities, the same as the branch network).

state.description: State, department or province of residence.

country.description: FIX: canonical country name without accents (Mexico, Colombia, Argentina), derived from country_raw after accent folding.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of country; use it for joins across tables (branches, products, transactions).

postal_code.description: FIX: postal code with Colombian 5-digit codes left-padded to 6 digits (Medellín and Barranquilla lost the leading zero in the source).

postal_code_raw.description: PII. Postal code as delivered (trimmed, upper-cased).

detected_accent.description: Regional accent detected on past calls, lower-cased; NULL for about 30% of customers.

credit_score.description: Credit score on the 300-850 scale. NULL for 15.0% of customers (see credit_score_null_reason); never imputed. Carries no delinquency signal (AUC 0.504), so it is not a risk label.

credit_score_null_reason.description: Why credit_score is NULL: 'missing' (not delivered) or 'invalid' (delivered but not a whole number); NULL when credit_score is present. Drives the insufficient-data path.

estimated_monthly_income.description: Estimated monthly income in the local currency of the customer's country (scales match MXN, COP and ARS; not stated in the source). NULL for 20.0% of customers; never imputed.

estimated_monthly_income_null_reason.description: Why estimated_monthly_income is NULL: 'missing' or 'invalid' (not numeric); NULL when present.

registration_date.description: Customer registration timestamp. Many products and transactions predate it (issue 8): see silver.products.opened_before_registration.

registration_branch_id.description: QUARANTINE: registering branch, only when it exists in the branch directory; NULL otherwise (149,995 of 150,000 values are orphans). Do not use it to answer 'your branch'.

registration_branch_id_raw.description: Registering branch identifier as delivered (trimmed, upper-cased), orphan or not.

registration_branch_orphan.description: True when registration_branch_id_raw is present but matches no branch (the value was nulled).

customer_status.description: Customer status, current state only (no timestamp). Not a churn label. Precedence rule: Closed or Suspended customers go to a human. 90% of Closed customers still hold an Active product: see silver.products.customer_status_conflict.

last_updated.description: Last update of the customer record as delivered; 9,258 values fall after the snapshot as-of date (see last_updated_after_as_of).

last_updated_after_as_of.description: FLAG: last_updated is later than the snapshot as-of date 2026-06-18 (future-dated record, up to 2027-06).

doc_type_inconsistent.description: FLAG: document_type is not issued by the customer's country (DNI outside Argentina, CC/CE outside Colombia). True for all 74,907 Mexican customers (DNI). Values are kept; identity validation must not assume a national format.

checks.name: document_number_format
checks.expr: document_number RLIKE CASE document_type WHEN 'DNI' THEN '^[0-9]{8}$' WHEN 'CC' THEN '^[0-9]{10}$' WHEN 'CE' THEN '^[0-9]{7}$' WHEN 'Pasaporte' THEN '^[A-Z][0-9]{7}$' END
checks.description: Document number matches its type (DNI 8 digits, CC 10, CE 7, passport letter + 7 digits).

checks.name: doc_type_matches_country
checks.description: Document type is issued by the customer's country; failures are the Mexican DNI rows.

checks.name: registration_branch_found
checks.description: Raw registration branch exists in the branch directory; failures were nulled.

checks.name: email_format
checks.expr: email IS NULL OR email RLIKE '^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+[.][a-z]{2,}$'
checks.description: E-mail is syntactically valid when present.

checks.name: phone_prefix_matches_country
checks.expr: (mobile_phone IS NULL OR mobile_phone LIKE CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN '+52 %' WHEN 'CO' THEN '+57 %' WHEN 'AR' THEN '+54 %' END) AND (landline_phone IS NULL OR landline_phone LIKE CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN '+52 %' WHEN 'CO' THEN '+57 %' WHEN 'AR' THEN '+54 %' END)
checks.description: Dialing prefix of the mobile and landline phones matches the customer's country (Mexican numbers carry +54).

checks.name: postal_code_format
checks.expr: postal_code IS NULL OR CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}$' WHEN 'CO' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}$' WHEN 'AR' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[A-Z][0-9]{4}([A-Z]{3})?$' END
checks.description: Postal code matches the national format after the fix (MX 5 digits, CO 6 digits, AR CPA).

checks.name: postal_code_as_delivered
checks.expr: postal_code IS NULL OR postal_code = postal_code_raw
checks.description: Counts rows whose postal code was re-padded (FIX applied).

checks.name: accent_matches_country
checks.expr: detected_accent IS NULL OR detected_accent = CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 'mexican' WHEN 'CO' THEN 'colombian' WHEN 'AR' THEN 'argentine' END
checks.description: Detected accent agrees with the country of residence.

checks.name: adult_at_registration
checks.expr: date_of_birth IS NULL OR registration_date IS NULL OR add_months(date_of_birth, 216) <= to_date(registration_date)
checks.description: Customer was at least 18 years old at registration.

checks.name: last_updated_not_after_as_of
checks.description: Record was not updated after the snapshot as-of date 2026-06-18.

checks.name: last_updated_after_registration
checks.expr: last_updated IS NULL OR registration_date IS NULL OR last_updated >= registration_date
checks.description: The record was not updated before the customer registered.
